authority.integrationRule: review exact donor ancestry and diff, then forward-sync the canonical change without hand-copying or blindly cherry-picking

acceptance: Add stage-specific diagnostics for existing-install quiesce acquire, revalidate, old-uninstaller handoff, replacement, and release without logging tokens.
Make same-version passive /UPDATE preserve edition-owned files and shortcuts while replacing only the exact product installation.
Keep cross-process runtime mutation fail-closed and preserve DroneDreamRuntime and all other Edition installations.
Cover fake existing-install, busy, pending, stale-owner, command-failure, and successful update paths before any real installer attempt.
Prove Universal, Sim, Lab, Field, and legacy DroneDream product identities are parameters rather than hard-coded cleanup targets.
Derive trusted app identity from the native bundle identifier, never from a frontend mode switch.
Use an authorization-code PKCE S256 callback whose app identity, state, nonce, and one-time verifier are bound to one user-initiated attempt.
Use edition-scoped OS credential-vault and local-session namespaces while allowing the same backend account subject.
A browser account session may avoid password entry but cannot complete Lab authentication until the user clicks Lab sign-in and the Lab callback succeeds.
Render login and browser callback from the trusted Edition identity using exact canonical Edition assets and tokens; do not redraw, use concept directories, or let branding grant authority.
Reject callback, state, nonce, verifier, vault, or session material issued for another Edition.
Add cross-Edition fake tests for Universal, Sim, Lab, and Field plus replay, mismatch, cancellation, and missing-identity negatives.

acceptance: Publish an exact clean canonical donor commit, manifest, per-file SHA-256 values, and render receipt for the approved large Edition suffix.
Keep the LAB mark, generated Windows icon, #A7E84A/#20C77A/#087E69 gradient, #F3FCEF light surface, and #092019 dark surface unchanged.
Use the exact canonical lockup bytes across sidebar, launcher, login, browser callback, installer-facing resources, taskbar, shortcuts, Website cards, and download metadata.
Make the public stylesheet contract validate imported generated Edition tokens without duplicating token definitions into Lab-owned CSS.
Do not source from visualizations or concept directories, redraw geometry, replace U+00B7, or let visual mode grant hardware authority.
Parameterize the test-only allow fixture with the exact active Edition manifest hash and refresh every dependent context hash.
Keep a separate negative test proving that a mismatched Edition manifest hash is denied.
Do not change production validation, permit frontend authority, or create an allow path for the zero-validated-pack catalog.
